name: company-dossier
description: Build competitive intelligence dossiers on any company. Deep crawl + Wayback + DNS + tech stack, plus AI analysis with live web research (overcomes bot-blocked sites), social content pull, and a 12-section dossier with sourced, confidence-tagged findings.

chatParticipants.name: dossier
chatParticipants.description: Build competitive intelligence dossiers on any company

commands.name: research
commands.description: Research a company: /research Company Name https://company.com

companyDossier.anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key for AI-powered analysis (console.anthropic.com). Without this, data is collected but LLM synthesis is skipped.

companyDossier.model.description: Anthropic model for AI analysis + web research. Haiku = cheapest (default); Sonnet = stronger; Opus = most capable but most expensive (web search makes runs token-heavy).

companyDossier.maxPages.description: Maximum pages to crawl from the target website's sitemap.

companyDossier.socialPull.description: Pull public content (photos, videos, posts) from discovered social media profiles. Requires gallery-dl, yt-dlp, and/or instagrapi.

companyDossier.socialMaxPosts.description: Maximum posts/videos to pull per social platform.

companyDossier.socialDownloadMedia.description: Download actual media files (photos/videos). When off, only metadata is collected. Turn on for deep research.
